Every question in this bank is grounded in specific statements from that handbook text across its 14 sections -- licensing/testing requirements, GDL/instruction-permit/probationary-license rules and sponsorship, regular-license renewal and out-of-state/REAL ID transfers, right-of-way, speed and following distance, intersections/stopping/sight distance, turning/passing/backing/parking, vehicle communication (lights/horn/signals), the four sign categories plus railroad crossings, traffic signals and pavement markings, special lanes and roundabouts, other driving situations (metered ramps, DDIs, traffic stops, deer, funeral processions), weather/winter/rural-farm driving, crash and roadside-emergency procedures, alcohol/drug/distracted/drowsy driving, sharing the road, the points/habitual-offender/occupational-license system, and seat belts/insurance/other requirements -- no invented facts and no generic 'common knowledge' padding. Exam mechanics: CONFIRMED directly from the handbook itself (Section 1: Driving Test Requirements, p.1) -- the Wisconsin Knowledge Test has 50 questions, requires 40 correct (80%) to pass, and 'will take about 45 minutes to complete' (an expected/allotted duration stated by the handbook, though not framed as a hard countdown clock -- applicants are told to 'allow enough time to complete the test prior to when the DMV customer service center is scheduled to close'). The separate Highway Signs Test has 15 questions, requiring 12 correct (80%) to pass. Both are free at a DMV service center with no appointment needed; applicants ages 15-17 may also take the knowledge test online for a $10 fee via knowtodrive.com/wisconsin. These are official, directly-sourced numbers, not defaults or guesses. Content depth: the handbook's substantive body runs roughly 55 pages (Sections 1-12, excluding the website-link appendix and practice quiz), each page dense with concrete, quotable rules (exact hour/day/feet/percentage figures throughout) -- comparable in richness to other Driver tracks already built this session. This pool of 274 raw questions across 23 topic-bucket files is honestly supported by that material, not padded; thin or purely visual/graphic sign-image content (e.g. several sign-shape illustrations with minimal accompanying text) was either grounded carefully in the surrounding prose or omitted rather than guessed at.
